gen-gf-sniglet-lora: Lora brings a literary, bookish voice with hairline thinning at its curves, while Sniglet stays blunt and rounded, with terminals that stop short of curling. Over pages of text, it moves along gently.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-gambetta: Gambetta reads bookish and graceful, its strokes shifting in weight along each curve, while Underdog holds every stroke at a measured thickness. Their strongest quality is the contrast in line.
gen-gf-underdog-lora: Expressive and commanding, Underdog draws plain strokes like stitched thread. Lora, a serif with a mellow swing from thick to thin, gives it a bookish counterpart that makes the two feel lively together.
gen-gf-unkempt-lora: Unkempt has a pencil-line consistency, its t crossbar and stem matching in weight, while Lora, a classic serif, adds modest stress in its curves. Their strongest quality is a loose, scrawled voice meeting a bookish one.
gen-luckiest-guy-fs-bespoke-slab: Loud and cheerful, Luckiest Guy pours its ink at one width, with round o shapes that have constant walls, while Bespoke Slab, a classic serif, stands low and grounded. Their strongest quality is the shout meeting the refined.
gen-zen-dots-lora: Techy and friendly, Zen Dots gives every letter generous room, while Lora, a text serif, adds a subtle pen-like modulation in its bowls. One is built for impact, the other for literary reading.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-merriweather-sans: Expressive from the first word, Autour One keeps a clear channel into each round letter and one line weight in its g. Merriweather Sans follows with sturdy, tall lowercase, so a long read stays steady and unhurried.
gen-gf-goldman-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans sets sturdy, tall lowercase with an open e, under Goldman's widely spaced, bold letters. Across many paragraphs it stays clean and easy on the eye, never tiring.
gen-megrim-fs-quicksand: Megrim's c is open as a bent paperclip, and every stroke ends at the same measured thickness, giving it an angular, futuristic edge. Quicksand then follows with rounded, glassy bowls and identical bar thickness, a friendly counterweight that keeps the page approachable.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-merriweather-sans: Expressive and distinctive, Tektur has a pipe-cleaner look, with generous terminal openings on every curve and oversized lowercase. Merriweather Sans keeps paragraphs sturdy and clean, its tall lowercase making each line feel large and easy to follow.
